title: Delivery & data
description: ZeroCut-scoped NGINX delivery, Cloudflare tunnel health, and the PostgreSQL and ClickHouse services used by the application. The postgres17 cluster is namespace-shared, so its panels are an impact view rather than per-query attribution. ClickHouse panels are scoped to ZeroCut's dedicated instance.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (method, host, path, status) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_requests{exported_namespace="personal-projects",ingress=~"zerocut.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, host, path) (rate(nginx_ingress_controller_response_duration_seconds_bucket{exported_namespace="personal-projects",ingress=~"zerocut.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Backup age
panels.description: Empty means the shared postgres17 cluster currently reports no available base backup timestamp.

panels.title: Healthy shards
panels.description: Three means every unique production shard is reporting.

panels.title: Memory and NVMe volume use
panels.description: The PVCs are node-local thin ZFS volumes; this is written data, not their logical growth ceiling.
